resharper_csharp_space_after_logical_not_op #

After unary operators — Logical not operator (!). Measured on its own: at true the oracle writes ! a and ! (o is string) and leaves -a, +a, &a and *p where they were, so it is one of the five keys space_after_unary_operator generalizes rather than a spelling of it.
